ValidationRule.description: IM-472: Sub Breakout Foundation code can only have Breakout Foundation Code as a Parent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Foundation_Code_Validation__c && AND( ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Sub Breakout'), NOT(ISBLANK(Parent__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent__r.Type__c ,'Breakout')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sub Breakout Foundation code can only have 'Breakout' Foundation Code as a parent.
